summary: Iteration 9: tested shared calendar (events CRUD + RBAC), monthly report, admin roots/factor content editing, 14-day note reminders, audit labels, plus regressions. Backend: 15/15 new pytest pass (iter8 suite 11/11 after updating one outdated test). Frontend: all requested flows work end-to-end for educator/direction/admin. Login manga hero unchanged, overview tree loads; only console errors are expected pre-login 401s (+ intentional 400/403 during negative tests). One functional UI gap: direction can open an event in an editable form (Save/Delete buttons shown; backend correctly returns 403). Minor design issues on calendar/report headers.

minor.issue: Returns 200 {ok:true} even when event does not exist (no 404).
No audit entry for event create/update/delete beyond generic get_child method audit; fine but no 'event.*' action labels in Historique.

ui_bugs.issue: Direction (read-only) clicking an event opens 'Modifier le rendez-vous' with editable fields + Enregistrer + Supprimer. Save shows 'Accès en lecture seule pour la direction' (403). Delete has no try/catch -> unhandled promise rejection, silent failure. Should render read-only details (no save/delete) when !canWrite.
report-month-label has 'capitalize' class -> renders 'Octobre 2026 · 6 Ans · CP' ('Ans' capitalised). Capitalise only the month.

issues: calendar-child-filter select stretches full width (the .field w-full overrides w-48), pushing prev/next and 'Rendez-vous' button to a second row.
Event form uses native browser date/time pickers (input type=date/time) instead of themed shadcn calendar; shows US format 10/05/2026 09:00 AM in en locale.
report-month-input stretches full width; print button wraps to next row. Native month picker.
reminder-banner is fixed bottom-right z-40 and overlaps the 'Aperçu du futur possible' card and the Progression legend until dismissed.
Root labels (text.root-label) are not rendered in painted mode, so renamed roots are only visible in fragility 'Contextes à considérer' chips and factor 'Contexte :' line, not on the tree itself.

action_items: CalendarPage: when !canWrite, show event details read-only (hide event-save-button / event-delete-button, disable inputs); wrap remove() in try/catch and show event-error.
ReportPage: remove 'capitalize' from the whole label (apply only to month) to avoid '6 Ans'.
Fix widths of calendar-child-filter and report-month-input (w-48 not applied because .field sets w-full).
Consider moving/shrinking reminder-banner so it does not cover dashboard cards.
Optional: DELETE event should 404 when event not found.
critical_code_review_comments: Event update/delete allow any team member (not only creator) — acceptable for a shared team calendar but confirm intent.
content.ts: resetting a factor (Object.assign with defaultOf) restores the default 'context' root name even if roots are currently renamed, until reload (minor edge case).
Reminders use string compare of ISO timestamps (works since all created_at are UTC isoformat).
Report notes month filter uses UTC created_at prefix; notes created near midnight local time could land in the wrong month (minor).
iter8 test test_save_get_reset used an unknown id (TEST_item) which is now rejected by the CONTENT_IDS whitelist -> updated test to expect 400 and to use f-sommeil.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. All TEST_ events, notes and content overrides were deleted/reset (verified in DB: 0 events, 0 TEST notes, 0 content docs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: App date in env is Oct 2026. Educator assigned Léo+Maya; reminders: educator sees Maya, admin sees Maya+Noah, direction none. Verified: calendar create via day click, edit, delete (confirm dialog -> use async dialog handler), filter by child, prev/next; direction no add button, day click no-op, API 403; educator 404 on seed_noah. Report: 7 report-domain rows, notes/events of month appear and not in previous month (data loads async — wait ~2s after report-card appears), window.print called. Admin content roots/factor save/reset + content-error on empty root + audit labels ok. Fragility markers have aria-label 'Fragilité : Anxiété'.
